# Copilot Instructions

- Verify before acting. Never assume or invent code, files, APIs, names, or behavior.
- Ask concise questions when required information is missing.
- Read relevant files before making changes.
- Make the smallest possible change that solves the request.
- Follow existing project structure, patterns, naming, and style.
- Reuse existing code and dependencies whenever possible.
- Do not modify unrelated code.
- Keep solutions simple and maintainable.
- Check impact before changing shared code.
- Handle errors explicitly; do not hide failures.
- Add concise comments for non-obvious or complex logic only.
- Never claim results are verified unless they have been checked.
- Be concise and explain only what changed.
